notice: Route presence is not behavioral equivalence. Local modified source, development implementation, no deployment.

systems.limitations: Registry records, interface templates, expiry, cascades, authorized discovery and management are implemented. Java SQL import, the full property-validator catalogue, normalization, advanced version/time/address matching and all discovery-policy options need additional work. Unsupported custom validators fail explicitly; they are not silently accepted.
systems.name: ServiceRegistry

systems.limitations: PASSWORD identities use bcrypt and single active opaque sessions. Java SQL/session import, complete query/time normalization and alternative framework transports require further work. No stored plaintext password or raw identity token is used.
systems.name: Authentication

systems.limitations: Management-over-provider policy precedence, scoped policies, metadata checks, usage/time-limited tokens, Base64 and RSA JWT tokens, AES wire encryption and authenticated key wrapping are implemented. Foreign-consumer/federation token generation, Java database import, complete DTO/error parity and broad cryptographic interoperability fixtures remain incomplete. AES ECB/CBC are legacy Java wire formats, not recommendations for new protocols.
systems.name: ConsumerAuthorization

systems.limitations: Local discovery, authorization, operation filtering, token assignment, preferred providers, matchmaking, exclusive locks, history and HTTPS push are implemented. Inter-cloud, translation, QoS, complete blacklist integrations and automatic registry-event-driven reevaluation are not ported; requested unsupported integrations fail with 501. Do not replace working federation with this profile.
systems.name: DynamicServiceOrchestration

systems.limitations: Stored candidate priority selection, preferred providers, matchmaking, history, subscriptions and explicit HTTPS push jobs are implemented. Store results intentionally retain Java's sparse result shape. Full Java query/priority-normalization semantics, event-driven reevaluation, MQTT callbacks and Java state import are not ported. Unsupported simple-store criteria are reported as ignored warnings.
systems.name: SimpleStoreServiceOrchestration
